estimates: Official precinct coordinate is the best available anchor for the Great Stupa centre. Move the model only if a better survey identifies that centre.
The model shows the excavated remains. Adjacent votive base placements, localized collapse, individual masonry and peripheral annexes are representative estimates.
No intact historical dome or sculptures are reconstructed. Separate Saidu Sharif I is outside the model scope.

review.notes: Published Qualla gallery was checked first. Uncertain drawn reconstructions, museum objects and attribution-required photographs were excluded. The excavator’s written measurements and official current site control the Ruins model.
